home.tagline: A charades game for one phone and a whole crowd. Mimi hosts. Nobody talks.
home.author: Pedro Chapelin

home: Oh, you came. I've been waiting since forever.
Sit down. The chairs don't bite. Hardly ever.
Tonight nobody talks. I love silence.
murmurs: I used to be a person too. I think.
Your shoe is staring at me.
I counted you. There's one extra.
I live behind the curtain. It's cozy.
Has anyone seen my shadow? Oh, it's me.
I like you. The way I like cookies.
handoff: Pass the phone. Slowly. I'm watching.
Only tonight's star may look. Everyone else, close your eyes. Or don't.
Shhh. The word is hungry for secrets.
reveal: Memorize it. Then forget I exist.
Fate chose for you. I only watched.
Don't like it? I'll swap it. For a price.
acting: Use your whole body. I use all of mine.
The crowd is quiet. Too quiet.
tense: Time is running out. Mine never does.
Hurry, before the lights go out.
scoring: Who was it? You can tell me. I keep secrets.
Moment of truth. I adore the truth.
Point at whoever guessed. I'll remember.
hit: Bravo. I'll keep this applause in a little box.
You understand each other without words. Like me and the dark.
miss: Nobody? That's fine. I didn't get it either.
The word ran away. It'll come back. They always do.
winner: We have a star. I'll add it to my collection.
End of the show. Or the start of another?
rules: Set it however you like. I adapt to anything.
Rules are like shadows. Always nearby.
Choose carefully. Or don't. I'll have fun either way.
empty: The stage is empty. Just the way I like it.
Nobody here. Just me. As usual.
noSkips: No points, no swaps. I don't do credit.
It'll have to be this one. Be brave.
confirm: Leaving already? But the night is young.
Erase everything? I love erasing things.

solo.description: Whoever acts and whoever guesses both score. 2 to 15 people.

rules.title: How to play
rules.intro: MimiShow is played with one phone that goes from hand to hand. Mimi takes care of the order, the draw, the timer and the scoreboard.

steps.title: Assemble the cast
steps.body: Every star for themselves or teams. Add the players from oldest to youngest, set the points, the time and the swaps, and choose the word categories.

steps.title: Get your word
steps.body: Whoever acts taps "That's me". The difficulty is drawn at random (easy is worth 1 point, medium 2, hard 3) and the word only shows while a finger holds the card.

steps.title: Swap if you need
steps.body: Each turn has some free swaps. After that, every swap costs 1 point, and with no points you can't swap.

steps.title: Act it out
steps.body: Start the timer and act out the word without talking, sounds or pointing at objects. Everyone else shouts their guesses.

steps.title: Score
steps.body: Solo: the guesser and the performer both score. Teams: the team scores. If time runs out with no guess, nobody scores.

steps.title: Close the curtains
steps.body: Whoever reaches the target first wins on the spot, and the show ends.

rules.forbidden: Off limits: talking, mouthing words, spelling letters in the air and pointing at the object itself.
